title: CODE Bunny
description:
In CODE Bunny, all combat techniques ARE movement options! You can cut through enemies in hand-crafted 2D environments with multiple routes as Axel and Hazel: Two characters with vastly different playstyles!

Experience 7 Action-packed Stages with multiple routes that encourage replayability, and discover the fastest way to get to the goal!

On Planet Lumna, you will encounter many different and unique locations, such as Futuristic Metropoles, Ruins covered by Forests, Floating Cities Above the Clouds, and More!

Face the mysterious group "Mad Bunny" in exciting Boss Fights with unique mechanics that will test your skills!

Perform intense acrobatics and dodge bullet patterns while delivering combos to stagger bosses in different ways!

In between Missions, you can take a breather from action with the "Talk Room" option, where you can sit back and relax with casual chats with your crewmates at Lagos Hyperbolics HQ - A Space Station orbiting Planet Lumna. Get to know more about them and the world they live in!

Axel, a former figure skater, and Hazel, a cunning warrior of the Xanadu Army. They now find themselves as members of the VY Space Program - A project aiming to harness the perfect energy source, Aethr, from Comet Yliaster.

Following the sudden appearance of Mad Bunny in Lumna City, Axel and Hazel are tasked with finding out what their plans are. However, they will uncover a hidden conspiracy, as well as many secrets behind the nature of the world they live in…

Witness CODE Bunny’s intensely emotional narrative with several charming characters by playing through Story Mode!

By clearing Story Mode, you can unlock Speedrun Mode and Boss Rush: Special challenges that will test your mastery of CODE Bunny!

• Speedrun Mode takes you to every stage in the game back to back! An in-game clock will record your best time. Try to compete with your friends to find out who’s the fastest!

• Boss Rush will take you to an alternate reality with a story diverging from CODE Bunny’s main narrative. Fight all bosses in the game back to back, and face an even more daunting challenge afterwards...

Get special gameplay rewards for beating the Extra Modes!
description_short: CODE Bunny is a Fast-paced 2D Action Platformer where combat mechanics and high-speed movement merge together! Master the play styles of two characters - Axel and Hazel - to deliver flashy and exciting attacks that rip through enemies! Can you run fast enough to uncover the secrets of Lumna?
